items.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have pianist and arranger Johnny Varro with me this morning

ctx.x: Okay. Well thanks for your time today.
Oh man it was great, Monk, you made it very easy.
Good. Good. And I’ll be waiting to hear that chart this afternoon to see how it goes.
